scope: Romanian representations of 59 of the 69 registered English core sources: 23 expansion representations and 36 earlier Romanian-language representations now stored centrally under core/ro. Ten sources have no local Romanian representation.
acceptance_scope: The 23 expansion representations retain their reviewed representation-level acceptance. The 36 earlier representations retain their prior statuses: 34 retained prior conversions with failed live rechecks, and two guidance retrieval candidates not trust-promoted. This path migration does not change acceptance, currentness, legal force, topic coverage, or country completion.
